expected_level_description: You can: - process requests for access to records - apply retention schedules and record-keeping standards
You can: - apply the retention schedule to records and flag those due for review - prepare records for archiving or secure destruction, and keep the audit trail
You can: - log, acknowledge, and track requests to meet time limits - gather and redact information, and draft responses for review - check the identity and authority of the person asking
You can: - check that a request to share information meets policy - keep records of what was shared, with whom, and why - draft simple information sharing agreements
You can: - log incidents and gather the facts - assess incidents against the organisation's severity criteria - track actions to close
You can: - run data quality checks and correct errors - explain data quality reports to colleagues
You can: - supervise day-to-day work and give feedback - take part in recruitment and induction - hold regular one-to-one conversations
